summary: FancyZones layout selection does not appear to persist independently for each Windows virtual desktop.

status.label: Reproduction needed
status.detail: This remains the canonical open issue after several related reports were closed as duplicates; current-build behavior and implementation path need verification.

next_action.label: Reproduce per-desktop layout persistence
next_action.reason: Test the documented one-monitor, multiple-virtual-desktop flow and distinguish an editor display limitation from settings persistence.

judgment.rationale: The issue provides explicit steps on one physical monitor with multiple Windows virtual desktops, and later duplicate reports describe the same layout-sharing behavior. The issue is the live canonical thread; local reproduction is warranted before design.
evidence: Live issue #20222 is open, unassigned, and labels include Issue-Bug, Product-FancyZones, Needs-Triage.
The issue reports that the editor shows one desktop and users must relaunch it on each desktop to select layouts.
Later related reports #27491, #32453, and #36968 were closed as duplicates to #20222; #36968 had a user confirmation in v0.88.0 before closure.
The latest comment on #20222 says the functionality used to work, leaving current expected behavior and regression timing unclear.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the separate-layout flow on a current supported build and confirm whether the desktop-specific state is still unsupported or regressed.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report identifies a focused comparison, but no current PowerToys failure mechanism has been demonstrated. Run the comparison before proposing a code change.

issue_context.summary: The open FancyZones issue asks for independent layouts on Windows virtual desktops and reports the editor showing only one desktop at a time.
known_information: Live state is open; reporter zarthcode; no assignees; labels: Issue-Bug, Product-FancyZones, Needs-Triage.
Created 2022-09-01; issue body reports PowerToys 0.61.1 running as administrator and multiple virtual desktops on one physical monitor.
The reporter’s workaround is to open the editor separately on each virtual desktop and select a layout; expected behavior is a per-desktop editor/settings view.
The latest comment (2025-01-31) says the functionality used to work and questions why the related report was not closed in favor of this issue.
Related issues #27491 (2024), #32453 (2024), and #36968 (2025) were explicitly closed as duplicates of #20222. #36968 was confirmed still present in v0.88.0 before closure.
inferences: The newer duplicate reports make a virtual-desktop layout issue more likely than a monitor-resolution issue, but they do not prove the exact current support contract.
The latest commenter may have meant #36968 when referring to a similar-numbered issue; the timeline independently confirms #36968 was closed in favor of #20222.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is the canonical tracker entry: #27491 and #36968 explicitly point to it, and #32453 asks users to add a bug report here if the behavior persists. The existing text may mix an editor-display request with per-desktop persistence. Reproduce the newer, narrower behavior before proposing implementation details.
initial_investigation: Read live body, four comments, labels, assignees, and relevant timeline events. The issue remains open and unassigned.

Checked linked issues: #27491 explicitly duplicates to #20222; #36968 was closed to #20222 after a v0.88.0 confirmation; #32453 asks reporters to use #20222. #20242 is about resolution-based preferences, a distinct axis.
Checked current MuyuanMS/PowerToys issue/PR search; no covering fork trace was found.
discussion_summary: The 2022 report has screenshots and PowerToys diagnostic reports; an additional commenter proposed switching templates on the fly, which is not the same requirement.
A 2025 comment on #36968 confirmed the layout behavior persisted in v0.88.0 and maintainers closed that report as a duplicate to #20222.
The latest #20222 commenter says the behavior used to work but gives no version or regression window.

actions.label: Reproduce distinct layouts across virtual desktops
actions.note: Later duplicate reports confirm the behavior, but reproduce on a current supported build before designing a fix.

reproduce.title: Verify FancyZones layout state across Windows virtual desktops
reproduce.version_requirement: Use a current supported PowerToys build and record the exact version; the original report was on 0.61.1 and a duplicate confirmed behavior on 0.88.0.
prerequisites: Windows 11 with one physical monitor and at least two virtual desktops.
setup: Open the FancyZones editor on each desktop and select visibly different layouts.
steps: Close the editor and switch between the virtual desktops.
Reopen the editor on each desktop and observe which desktop/layout is shown.
Change one layout, switch away and back, and confirm whether the second desktop’s selection changes.
reproduce.expected_result: Each virtual desktop presents and retains its own selected layout if independent per-desktop layouts are supported; otherwise the current product behavior is recorded without assuming a defect.
